_comment: Generated-art provenance history. The current contemporary art-v1 pack is indexed below; earlier source PNGs, prompts and hashes remain preserved in the assets array. Live UI continues to be rendered by the client rather than flattened concept screenshots.
_current_comment: Current runtime assets use the unified contemporary art-v1 pack. The entries below preserve earlier source artwork and prompts for provenance.

assets.prompt: Create ONE original game-ready terrain texture image for a 2D cooperative fantasy adventure game. Asset use: a quiet arena floor, stretched across a hexagonal room in a native desktop game; the engine draws its own hex grid over it. Square canvas, full bleed, top-down orthographic flat surface. Muted slate blue stone with soft worn mineral mottling and sparse tiny warm sandstone flecks. A hand-painted indie adventure aesthetic, broad restrained shapes, low contrast, readable behind characters, predominantly dark cool blue gray. Even lighting everywhere, texture feels continuous and unobtrusive. No perspective, no borders, no text, no grid, no hexagons, no objects, no cracks that look like impassable walls, no bright highlights, no characters, no UI. Keep the edges compatible for tiling. Output an opaque high-quality square raster texture.

Create ONE original transparent-background character sprite for a 2D fantasy adventure desktop game. A compact armored warrior automaton, broad shoulders, navy steel armor, warm brass trim, small glowing teal visor, a short broad sword in the right hand and a small round shield in the left. Friendly but capable, no franchise references. Three-quarter top-down view, facing down and slightly right, entire body including boots visible, camera elevated enough to see helmet top. Stylized hand-painted indie game asset with crisp dark outlines, simplified large shapes and restrained highlights, readable when reduced to 48 pixels. Static neutral ready pose, sword short and close to body, compact centered silhouette, generous clean transparent padding. All character details must remain within one single cutout, no ground plane, no cast shadow outside silhouette, no scenery, no text, no UI, no extra weapons or props, no sprite sheet. True transparent alpha background.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: production background for native game main menu.
Input image: the approved main menu design, edit target.
Primary request: turn this approved image into a clean background asset. Remove ALL user interface text and buttons: remove HSMultiplayer, all three rectangular buttons and their Chinese labels, remove version at bottom left. Reconstruct those areas as the same clean, softly lit off-white workshop wall/negative space, keep left third quiet and very low detail so native live UI can be drawn there. Keep the scene composition, practical modern studio/workshop, table, pegboard, concrete hex floor, storage shelves, computer, plants and warm daylight exactly in the approved style. Preserve 16:9 landscape framing and full bleed. This must be only the illustrated environment, NO text, NO logos, NO buttons, NO icons, NO HUD, NO added characters.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production floor texture for the approved modern base/workshop game, square opaque seamless texture.
Input image: reference only for pale warm gray concrete color and restrained near-modern game art.
Primary request: create one flat top-down orthographic CONCRETE FLOOR TEXTURE for a native 2D adventure game. Warm light-gray microcement with very subtle irregular aggregate, soft broad tonal variation, low contrast, quiet behind small characters and white/charcoal HUD. Surface only, evenly lit, full bleed, no perspective, no vignette, no borders, no hex grid (engine draws its own grid), no tile seams, no objects, no text, no emblems, no UI, no bright patches, no dramatic cracks, no dirt piles, no shadows. Practical clean studio/workshop feel. Compatible edges for tiling, no obvious directional lighting. It is NOT slate stone, medieval paving, marble or sci-fi metal.
